Jacqueline Scholl 2024, based on Legrand 2022 (and their R code)

Note: to preprocess the heart rate signal, i.e. look for outliers, we used the systole package from LEgrand and Allen (2022) in Python and upload the results here.

# Packages, loading
Load the raw data, but also the pre-processed data, so that we can compare our and their results

Data columns:

- Condition: 'Less' or 'More',refers to response BPM being smaller than ('less') listenBPM
- Modality: Extero or Intero, refers to two task conditoins, comparing either the heart beat or external sounds
- Decision: 'Less' or 'More', refers to participants ratings
- DecisionRT
- Confidence: rating of confidence in the response
- ConfidenceRT
- ResponseCorrect: whether Decision and Condition match
- listenBPM and responseBPM: the beats per minute of the sound/heart in the 'listening' and 'comparing' intervals


Columns with only the sae entry for each:
- TrialType?? all are 'psi'
- StairCond, all 'psi'

From their model?:
- Alpha
- EstimatedThreshold
- EstimatedSlope

From the paper:
- rejecting trials with responses < 100ms
- rejecting trials with 'unreliable heartbeat signal', i.e. absolute deviation around the median rule (Leys et al. 2013), i.e. outliers in average heart rate or standard deviation of pulse-to-pulse interval an outlier

In the code from the original paper, they're R files are in docs>source>examples>R

# Illustrations
To look at data quality:
- number of trials removed based on heart rate measure or on RT
- average % accuracy

To understand the task (for this just using the good data:
- difference between listen and response BPM; separately for the two modalities
- % choice against difference listen and response (for the two modalities separately). If we were to fit hierarchical models, we could get that automatically
- histogram of decision RTs
- histogram of confidence ratings, for the two conditions
- confidence against choice difficulty


```{r}
# Outliers

  dplyr::summarize(ntr=n(),
                   count.heartRateOutlier=sum(HeartRateOutlier=='True',na.rm=T),
                   count.RTOutlier=sum(RTOutlier==T,na.rm=T),
```

# Control analyses - mean heart rate
Overall CDM has a higher heart rate than NDM, no difference in SD of average heart rate across trials.
Is this due to order effects?

```{r}
heart.rates.mean.sd= cardio %>% group_by(session,ID,order) %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(listenBPM.mean=mean(listenBPM),
                   listenBPM.sd  = sd(listenBPM)) %>% 
                   #DV_ResponseMinListen.listenBPM.cor = cor(listenBPM,DV_ResponseMinListen)) %>%
  pivot_wider(.,id_cols=c('ID','order'),names_from='session',values_from=c('listenBPM.mean','listenBPM.sd')) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(heartRate.mean_cdm_min_ndm = listenBPM.mean_CDM-listenBPM.mean_NDM,
                heartRate.sd_cdm_min_ndm = listenBPM.sd_CDM-listenBPM.sd_NDM)

lm.heartrate.mean=lm(heartRate.mean_cdm_min_ndm~ 1+order,data=heart.rates.mean.sd)
lm.heartrate.sd=lm(heartRate.sd_cdm_min_ndm~ 1+order,data=heart.rates.mean.sd)
summary(lm.heartrate.mean)
summary(lm.heartrate.sd)

heart.rates.mean.sd %>% dplyr::ungroup() %>% dplyr::summarize_if(is.numeric,mean)

# correlations of heart rate with DV
cor.HR.DV = cardio %>% dplyr::filter(Modality=='Intero') %>% group_by(session,ID,order) %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(DV_ResponseMinListen.listenBPM.cor = cor(listenBPM,DV_ResponseMinListen))

cor.HR.DV %>% dplyr::group_by(session) %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(mean.cor=mean(DV_ResponseMinListen.listenBPM.cor,na.rm=T))

t.test(cor.HR.DV %>% dplyr::filter(session=='CDM') %>% pull(DV_ResponseMinListen.listenBPM.cor))
t.test(cor.HR.DV %>% dplyr::filter(session=='NDM') %>% pull(DV_ResponseMinListen.listenBPM.cor))
```

# Fit models for each person, for each session, for each condition:
- choice (more/less) ~ stimulus difficulty + ? stimulus per se + ? response repetition bias?
- confidence: they have the relationship between confidence and ground truth accuracy


Key models for the paper: choice and confidence
##Fit
Note that the scaling was done across all subjects, on an ungrouped data frame, not within each person.
Control analyses:
- including the heart beat (but result a bit weird, maybe it's and (A-B) and A issue), therefore
- include sound
- includ mean(heart+sound)
- heart and sound separately
- basic, non-zscored
- basic, zscored within person
- for log likelihoods: use non-zscored
```{r}
results.indivModalities=data.frame()
results.indivModalities.notScaled.forPlot=data.frame()
results.allModalities=data.frame()
results.logLiks = data.frame()

cardio.scaled=cardio %>% dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  
  dplyr::mutate_at(vars(c('DV_ResponseMinListen','easiness_ResponseMinListen.abs','DecisionRT','Confidence',
                          'listenBPM','listen.responseBPM.mean','responseBPM','rollingResponseAvg.prev','rollingResponseAvg.5tr.prev','DV_ResponseMinAvg5tr',
                          'rollingHeartAvg.5tr','DV_ResponseMinAvgListen5tr')),scale)
for (isub in unique(cardio$ID)){
  dft=cardio.scaled %>% dplyr::filter(ID==isub) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Decision = dplyr::recode(Decision,'More'=1,'Less'=0),
                  ResponseCorrect = dplyr::recode(ResponseCorrect,'True'=1,'False'=0))
  dft.nonScaled=cardio %>% dplyr::ungroup() %>% dplyr::filter(ID==isub) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Decision = dplyr::recode(Decision,'More'=1,'Less'=0))
  for (isess in unique(dft$session)){
    for (imod in unique(dft$Modality)){
      #print(paste(isub,isess,imod)) #s07 NDM Extero"
      df= dft %>% dplyr::filter(session==isess & Modality==imod)
      df.nonScaled = dft.nonScaled %>% dplyr::filter(session==isess & Modality==imod)
      df.zscoredWithinSub= df %>% dplyr::mutate_at(vars(c('DV_ResponseMinListen','easiness_ResponseMinListen.abs','DecisionRT','Confidence',
                          'listenBPM','listen.responseBPM.mean','responseBPM','rollingResponseAvg.5tr.prev', 'DV_ResponseMinAvg5tr')),scale)
      # Separately for each condition
      glms=list()
      glms$dec = glm(Decision~ DV_ResponseMinListen,data=df,family='binomial')
      # Control analyses
      glms$dec.withListenBPM = glm(Decision~ DV_ResponseMinListen+ listenBPM,data=df,family='binomial')
      glms$dec.withResponseBPM = glm(Decision~ DV_ResponseMinListen+ responseBPM,data=df,family='binomial')
      glms$dec.withAvgListenResponseBPM = glm(Decision~ DV_ResponseMinListen+ listen.responseBPM.mean,data=df,family='binomial')
      glms$dec.listenRespBPMsep = glm(Decision~ listenBPM+responseBPM,data=df,family='binomial')
      glms$dec.zscoredWithin = glm(Decision~ DV_ResponseMinListen,data=df.zscoredWithinSub,family='binomial')
      glms$avgBeep.separate =  glm(Decision~listenBPM+rollingResponseAvg.prev+responseBPM,data=df.nonScaled,family='binomial')
      glms$avgBeep5tr.separate = glm(Decision~listenBPM+rollingResponseAvg.5tr.prev+responseBPM,data=df.nonScaled,family='binomial')
      glms$avgHeartRate5tr.separate = glm(Decision~rollingHeartAvg.5tr+responseBPM,data=df.nonScaled,family='binomial')
      # comparison: with avg vs with listen
      df.comparison= df.nonScaled %>% dplyr::select(Decision,DV_ResponseMinAvg5tr,DV_ResponseMinListen,responseBPM,DV_ResponseMinAvgListen5tr) %>% na.omit()
    
      glms$forLogLik.avgBeep5tr = glm(Decision ~ DV_ResponseMinAvg5tr,data=df.comparison,family='binomial')
      glms$forLogLik.listenBeep = glm(Decision ~ DV_ResponseMinListen,data=df.comparison,family='binomial')
      glms$forLogLik.responseBeepOnly = glm(Decision ~ responseBPM,data=df.comparison,family='binomial')
      glms$forLogLik.avgHeart5tr = glm(Decision ~ DV_ResponseMinAvgListen5tr,data=df.comparison,family='binomial')
      
      results.logLiks=bind_rows(results.logLiks,
                                data.frame(ID=isub,session=isess,Modality=imod,order=df.nonScaled$order[1],
                                           logLik.avgBeep5tr=logLik(glms$forLogLik.avgBeep5tr),
                                           logLik.listenBeep=logLik(glms$forLogLik.listenBeep),
                                           logLik.responseBeepOnly = logLik( glms$forLogLik.responseBeepOnly),
                                           logLik.responesBeepAvg5trlisten = logLik(glms$forLogLik.avgHeart5tr)))
     # glms$acc = glm(ResponseCorrect~ easiness_ResponseMinListen.abs,data=df,family='binomial')
     # glms$conf= lm(Confidence ~ easiness_ResponseMinListen.abs+ResponseCorrect+DecisionRT,data=df)
      glms$conf= lm(Confidence ~ easiness_ResponseMinListen.abs,data=df)
      for (ireg in names(glms)){
        t=as.data.frame(summary(glms[[ireg]])$coefficients) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column() %>%
          dplyr::mutate(ID=isub,session=isess,Modality=imod,regression=ireg)
        results.indivModalities=bind_rows(results.indivModalities,t)
      }
      # For the plot also without scaling
      df.notscaled= cardio %>%  dplyr::filter(ID==isub & session==isess & Modality==imod) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(Decision = dplyr::recode(Decision,'More'=1,'Less'=0))
      glms.dec.notScaled=list()
      glms.dec.notScaled$dec= glm(Decision~DV_ResponseMinListen,data=df.notscaled,family='binomial')
      glms.dec.notScaled$dec.listenRespBPMsep = glm(Decision~ listenBPM+responseBPM,data=df,family='binomial')
      for (ireg in names(glms.dec.notScaled)){
        t=as.data.frame(summary(glms.dec.notScaled[[ireg]])$coefficients) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column() %>%
          dplyr::mutate(ID=isub,session=isess,Modality=imod,regression=ireg)
        results.indivModalities.notScaled.forPlot = bind_rows(results.indivModalities.notScaled.forPlot,t)
      }
     
      #t=as.data.frame(summary(glm.dec.notScaled)$coefficients) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column() %>%
      #    dplyr::mutate(ID=isub,session=isess,Modality=imod,regression='dec')
      
    }
    
    # Combining conditions
    df= dft %>% dplyr::filter(session==isess)
    glms=list()
    glms$dec= glm(Decision~ DV_ResponseMinListen*Modality,data=df,family='binomial')
    #glms$acc= glm(ResponseCorrect~ DV_ResponseMinListen*Modality,data=df,family='binomial')
    glms$conf= lm(Confidence ~ (easiness_ResponseMinListen.abs+ResponseCorrect+DecisionRT)*Modality,data=df)
    for (ireg in names(glms)){
        t=as.data.frame(summary(glms[[ireg]])$coefficients) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column() %>%
          dplyr::mutate(ID=isub,session=isess,regression=ireg)
        results.allModalities=bind_rows(results.allModalities,t)
      }
  }
}

    dplyr::mutate(Extero_CDMmNDM = CDM_Extero-NDM_Extero,
                  Intero_CDMmNDM = CDM_Intero-NDM_Intero)

  left_join(.,med.data,by='ID')
```

##Analyse the regression weights
Bayes factors to be done with JASP
```{r}
session.comparisons=data.frame()
#all.bfs=data.frame()

for (itype in unique(results.indivModalities$regression)){ #c('conf','dec','dec.withListenBPM')){ 
# make the difference CDM min NDM
  dft1=results.indivModalities %>% dplyr::filter(regression==itype) %>% dplyr::select(-`Std. Error`,-`z value`,-`t value`,-`Pr(>|t|)`,-'Pr(>|z|)')
  if (itype=='dec.listenRespBPMsep'){ # for this one add a row that combines them
    t = dft1 %>% 
      pivot_wider(.,id_cols=c('ID','order','session','Modality','regression'),values_from='Estimate',names_from='rowname') %>%
      dplyr::mutate(listen_minus_responseBPM_beta = listenBPM-responseBPM) %>% 
      dplyr::select(ID,order,session,Modality,listen_minus_responseBPM_beta,regression) %>%
      pivot_longer(.,cols=c('listen_minus_responseBPM_beta'),names_to='rowname',values_to='Estimate') 
    dft1= bind_rows(dft1,t)  
  }
  dft = dft1 %>%
    pivot_wider(.,id_cols=c('ID','rowname','order'),values_from='Estimate',names_from=c('session','Modality')) %>% #'Age','Sex',
    dplyr::mutate(Extero_CDMmNDM = CDM_Extero-NDM_Extero,
                  Intero_CDMmNDM = CDM_Intero-NDM_Intero,
                  # new:across sessions:
                  Extero_CDMandNDM = (CDM_Extero+NDM_Extero)/2,
                  Intero_CDMandNDM = (CDM_Intero+NDM_Intero)/2)
  
  
  # when itype is dec, let's also test the absolute
  if (stringr::str_detect(itype,'dec')){ #(itype=='dec'|itype=='dec.withListenBPM'){
    t= dft %>% dplyr::filter(rowname=='Intercept') %>%
      dplyr::mutate(rowname=dplyr::recode(rowname,Intercept="Intercept.abs"),
                    Intero_CDMmNDM=abs(CDM_Intero)-abs(NDM_Intero),
                    Extero_CDMmNDM=abs(CDM_Extero)-abs(NDM_Extero),
                    Extero_CDMandNDM = (abs(CDM_Extero)+abs(NDM_Extero))/2,
                    Intero_CDMandNDM = (abs(CDM_Intero)+abs(NDM_Intero))/2,
                    CDM_Intero=abs(CDM_Intero),
                    NDM_Intero=abs(NDM_Intero),
                    CDM_Extero=abs(CDM_Extero),
                    NDM_Extero=abs(NDM_Extero))
    dft=bind_rows(dft,t)
  }
  
  for (ibeta in unique(dft$rowname)){
    
    for (imodality in c('Intero','Extero')){
      df = dft %>% dplyr::filter(rowname==ibeta) %>% dplyr::select(order,contains(imodality),ID)
      
      # compute for each of CDM and NDM a t-test against zero (one-sample,two-sided)
      main.effects.p= df %>%  dplyr::select(-contains('CDMmNDM'),-contains('CDMandNDM')) %>%
        pivot_longer(cols=contains(imodality),names_to='session',values_to='value') %>%
        dplyr::group_by(session) %>% dplyr::summarize(p.value.session.mainEffect=t.test(value,mu=0)$p.value) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(rowname=ibeta,Modality=imodality,type=itype) %>% dplyr::select(session,p.value.session.mainEffect) %>%
        pivot_wider(.,names_from=session,values_from=p.value.session.mainEffect,names_prefix = 'p.value.session.mainEffect__') %>%
        # from the column name remove imodality
        dplyr::rename_all(~str_remove(.,imodality))
       main.effects.estimate= df %>%  dplyr::select(-contains('CDMmNDM'),-contains('CDMandNDM')) %>%
        pivot_longer(cols=contains(imodality),names_to='session',values_to='value') %>%
        dplyr::group_by(session) %>% dplyr::summarize(estimate.session.mainEffect=t.test(value,mu=0)$estimate) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(rowname=ibeta,Modality=imodality,type=itype) %>% dplyr::select(session,estimate.session.mainEffect) %>%
        pivot_wider(.,names_from=session,values_from=estimate.session.mainEffect,names_prefix = 'estimate.value.session.mainEffect__') %>%
        # from the column name remove imodality
        dplyr::rename_all(~str_remove(.,imodality))
       main.effects=cbind(main.effects.p,main.effects.estimate)
       
      # also combining both groups
      main.effects.groupsCombined=df %>% dplyr::select(contains('CDMandNDM')) %>%
        pivot_longer(cols=contains(imodality),names_to='session',values_to='value') %>% #dplyr::group_by(session) 
        dplyr::summarize(p.value.bothSessions.mainEffect=t.test(value,mu=0)$p.value,
                         estimate.value.bothSessions.mainEffect=t.test(value,mu=0)$estimate)
      
      # Regression
      this.lm= lm(formula=paste0(imodality,'_CDMmNDM~ 1+order'),data=df) 
      stats.summary=as.data.frame(summary(this.lm)$coefficients) %>% rownames_to_column(var='group.level.reg') %>% 
        # recode group.level.reg (Intercept) with NDM min CDM [!! note 30/5/2025: CDM min NDM, not other wsay round!]
        dplyr::mutate(group.level.reg=dplyr::recode(group.level.reg,`(Intercept)`='CDMminNDM')) %>%   #'NDMminCDM')) %>% 
        pivot_wider(names_from=group.level.reg,values_from=c('Estimate','Std. Error','t value','Pr(>|t|)'),names_sep='__')
      

      
      

      
      # control analysis: not controlling for order
      this.lm= lm(formula=paste0(imodality,'_CDMmNDM~ 1'),data=df) 
      stats.summary.notControlOrder=as.data.frame(summary(this.lm)$coefficients) %>% rownames_to_column(var='group.level.reg') %>% 
        # recode group.level.reg (Intercept) with NDM min CDM
        dplyr::mutate(group.level.reg=dplyr::recode(group.level.reg,`(Intercept)`='CDMminNDM')) %>% #'NDMminCDM')) %>% 
        dplyr::rename(Estimate.CDMmNDM.notControlOrder=Estimate, #dplyr::rename(Estimate.NDMmCDM.notControlOrder=Estimate,
                      `Std. Error.CDMmNDM.notControlOrder`=`Std. Error`, #`Std. Error.NDMmCDM.notControlOrder`=`Std. Error`,
                      `Pr(>|t|).CDMmNDM.notControlOrder`=`Pr(>|t|)`) #`Pr(>|t|).NDMmCDM.notControlOrder`=`Pr(>|t|)`)
     
      # new control analysis - Legrand suggestion: control for hear rate mean
      t= left_join(df,heart.rates.mean.sd %>% dplyr::select(ID,heartRate.mean_cdm_min_ndm),by='ID')
      this.lm= lm(formula=paste0(imodality,'_CDMmNDM~ 1+order+heartRate.mean_cdm_min_ndm'),data=t) 
      stats.summary.controlMeanHR=as.data.frame(summary(this.lm)$coefficients) %>% rownames_to_column(var='group.level.reg') %>% 
        # recode group.level.reg (Intercept) with NDM min CDM
        dplyr::mutate(group.level.reg=dplyr::recode(group.level.reg,`(Intercept)`='CDMminNDM')) %>% 
        dplyr::rename(Estimate.CDMmNDM.ctrHR=Estimate, 
                      `Std. Error.CDMmNDM.ctrHR`=`Std. Error`, 
                      `t value.CDMnNDM.ctrHR` = `t value`,
                      `Pr(>|t|).CDMmNDM.ctrHR`=`Pr(>|t|)`) 
      # From this analysis two things: is the p-value different for the intercept when controlling for heart rate difference? AND does the heart rate difference have an impact per se (take p-value and value of regressors?
      
        
      
      #if (itype=='dec' & imodality == 'Intero'){
      #  browser()
      #}
      
      # join
      this.stats.complete= cbind(main.effects,
                                 main.effects.groupsCombined,
                                 stats.summary,
                                 #BF.mean,
                                 stats.summary.notControlOrder) %>% 
                                 #stats.summary.controlMeanHR %>% dplyr::select(Estimate.CDMmNDM.ctrHR,`Pr(>|t|).CDMmNDM.ctrHR`)) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(Modality=imodality,Subject.level.regression.weight=ibeta,analysis.type=itype,
                      heartRate.mean_cdm_min_ndm.estimate=stats.summary.controlMeanHR %>% dplyr::filter(group.level.reg=="heartRate.mean_cdm_min_ndm") %>% pull(Estimate.CDMmNDM.ctrHR),
                      heartRate.mean_cdm_min_ndm.p = stats.summary.controlMeanHR %>% dplyr::filter(group.level.reg=="heartRate.mean_cdm_min_ndm") %>% pull(`Pr(>|t|).CDMmNDM.ctrHR`),
                      CDMmNDM.ctrHR.p = stats.summary.controlMeanHR %>% dplyr::filter(group.level.reg=="CDMminNDM") %>% pull(`Pr(>|t|).CDMmNDM.ctrHR`),
                      CDMmNDM.ctrHR.estimate = stats.summary.controlMeanHR %>% dplyr::filter(group.level.reg=="CDMminNDM") %>% pull(Estimate.CDMmNDM.ctrHR))
      session.comparisons=rbind(session.comparisons,this.stats.complete) 
      
      # all.bfs=rbind(all.bfs,BFs %>% 
      #                 dplyr::mutate(Modality=imodality,Subject.level.regression.weight=ibeta,analysis.type=itype))
      
    }
  }
}

write.csv(session.comparisons,file=file.path(paths$stats,'Interoception_NDMCDMcomparisons_fitSingleSub.csv'))
#write.csv(all.bfs ,file=file.path(paths$stats,'Interoception_NDMCDMcomparisons_BFsDifferentMethods_fitSingleSub.csv'))
```

## Decision curves with predictions

We can use the regression weights created above to create a predicted value of % choice for each person for each value
```{r}
x=seq(-51,51,1)
predictions=data.frame()
for (isub in unique(results.indivModalities.notScaled.forPlot$ID)){
  for (isess in c('NDM','CDM')){
    for (imod in c('Intero','Extero')){
      pars = results.indivModalities.notScaled.forPlot %>% dplyr::filter(ID==isub & session==isess & regression=='dec' & Modality==imod) %>% 
        dplyr::select(rowname,Estimate) %>%pivot_wider(.,values_from=Estimate,names_from=rowname)
      y = 1/(1+exp(-(pars$`(Intercept)`+x*pars$DV_ResponseMinListen)))
      predictions=rbind(predictions,
                        data.frame(DV_ResponseMinListen=x,perc.choice.predicted=y,ID=isub,session=isess,Modality=imod))
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
bins = data.frame(low=quantile(c(min(cardio$DV_ResponseMinListen)-0.5,cardio$DV_ResponseMinListen), probs = seq(0,0.9,0.1)), # to make sure we get the edges with the later rules
```

## Regression weights
For decision: 
- Intercept
- absolute intercept
- decision value
For confidence:
- all regression weights (+intercept)
Each split for the two groups. And split for intero/extero. Tim should add the statistics manually (nothing significant).
So the figure would be:
```{r}
# Create a figure with the regression weights from the data frame results.indivModalities. In the figure, there are 4 separate subplots, for each combination of Modality (Extero or Intero) and regression (dec or conf, ignoring acc). In each subplot, we want to show all regression weights (in the column 'rowname'), separately for each session (CDM or NDM). The regression weights should be plotted as mean and standard deviations. The figure should be saved as a pdf file in the folder paths$figures, with the name Interoception_RegressionWeights.pdf. The figure should have a title, and the x-axis should be labeled 'Regression weight'. The y-axis should be labeled 'Regression weight'. The x-axis should be rotated by 45 degrees. The colors should be the same as in the previous figure. 
plots=list()
df=results.indivModalities %>% dplyr::filter(regression %in% c('dec','conf')) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(rowname=dplyr::recode(rowname,`(Intercept)` = 'Intercept',
                DV_ResponseMinListen="Stimulus difference",easiness_ResponseMinListen.abs="Stimulus easiness",
                ResponseCorrect="Correct response",DecisionRT="RT (decision)"))

for (imod in c('Intero','Extero')){
  for (ireg in c('dec','conf')){
    df.this=df %>% dplyr::filter(Modality==imod,regression==ireg)
    if (ireg=='dec'){
      t= df.this %>% dplyr::filter(rowname=='Intercept') %>%
        dplyr::mutate(rowname=dplyr::recode(rowname,Intercept="Intercept.abs"),
                      Estimate=abs(Estimate))
      df.this=bind_rows(df.this,t) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(rowname=factor(rowname,ordered=T,levels=c('Stimulus difference','Intercept.abs','Intercept')))
    } else if (ireg=='conf'){
      df.this=df.this %>% dplyr::mutate(rowname=factor(rowname,ordered=T,levels=c('Stimulus easiness','Intercept')))
    }
    # plots[[paste0(imod,'_',ireg)]]=ggerrorplot(df.this,x='rowname',y='Estimate',color='session',ylab='Regression weights',add='jitter',
    #                                            add.params = list(size = 0.3),title='',size=0.4,desc_stat='mean_se') +
    #   rotate_x_text(45)+
    #   # add a horizontal line at y=0
    #   geom_hline(yintercept=0,linetype='dashed',color='black')+
    #   # change the color of session=NDM to blue and CDM to red
    #   scale_color_manual(values=c('CDM'='red','NDM'='blue'))+
    #   # remove the ylabel
    #   theme(axis.title.x=element_blank())
    
      
      jitterVal.abs=0.2
      df.this=df.this%>%dplyr::mutate(jitterVal=case_when(session=='CDM' ~ -jitterVal.abs,
                                                          T ~ jitterVal.abs),
                                      jitterVal=rnorm(nrow(df.this),mean=jitterVal,sd=0.05))
      summaryData = df.this %>%
        group_by(rowname, session) %>%
        summarise(meanEstimate = mean(Estimate)
                  , jitterVal = mean(jitterVal),
                  sdEstimate=sd(Estimate),
                  n=n(),
                  se = sdEstimate/sqrt(n)) %>%
        mutate(xmin = as.numeric(rowname)+jitterVal, #-0.04
               xend = as.numeric(rowname)+jitterVal) #+0.04)

      plots[[paste0(imod,'_',ireg)]]=ggplot(df.this, aes(x=as.numeric(rowname)+jitterVal, y=Estimate, group=ID)) +
        geom_point(size=1, aes(colour=session), alpha=0.7)+
        geom_line(size=1, alpha=0.1)+
        #scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0, 7.5), breaks=seq(0,7,by=1))+ 
        scale_colour_manual(values=c('CDM'='blue','NDM'='red'))+
        xlab('Regressor') +
        ggtitle('')+
        scale_x_continuous(limits=(c(0.5, 3.5)), breaks = seq(1,length(levels(df.this$rowname)),1)-0.1 , labels = levels(df.this$rowname))+
        ylab('Regression weights') +
        guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1))) +
        geom_point(data=summaryData,   size=2,aes(x=xmin,y=meanEstimate,color=session,group=NA))+
        geom_errorbar(data=summaryData,aes(x=xmin,y=meanEstimate,ymin=meanEstimate-se,ymax=meanEstimate+se,color=session,group=NA))+
        
        theme_bw()
      
  }
}
# Arrange the 4 plots of the list plots into a single figure with the function ggarrange. The plots should be arranged in 2 rows and 2 columns. The labels of the subplots should be 'A) Intero - Decision', 'B) Intero - Confidence', 'C) Extero - Decision', and 'D) Extero - Confidence'. The figure should have a title 'Regression weights'. The x-axis of the figure should have no label. The y-axis of the figure should be labeled 'Regression weight'. The x-axis of the figure should be rotated by 90 degrees. The figure should be saved as a pdf file in the folder paths$figures, with the name Interoception_RegressionWeights.pdf. There should be a shared legend across the 4 subplots.
figure=ggarrange(plots$Intero_dec,plots$Intero_conf,plots$Extero_dec,plots$Extero_conf,nrow=2,ncol=2,
          labels=c('A Intero - Decision','B Intero - Confidence','C Extero - Decision','D Extero - Confidence'),
          common.legend=T,
          # left align the labels
          hjust=0)

ggexport(figure,filename=file.path(paths$figures,'Interoception_RegressionWeights.tiff'),
         width=9*400,height=7*400,res=400)
```

```{r}
  dplyr::mutate("CDM min NDM, mean(s.e.)"=paste0(round(Estimate__CDMminNDM,digits=2),' (',round(Std..Error__CDMminNDM,digits=1),')'),
                "CDM min NDM (p)"=case_when(Pr...t..__CDMminNDM<0.01 ~ round(Pr...t..__CDMminNDM,digits=3),    #"NDM vs CDM (p)"
                                T ~ round(Pr...t..__CDMminNDM,digits=2)),

                "Order [NDM first] (p)" = case_when(Pr...t..__orderNDM.first<0.01 ~ round(Pr...t..__orderNDM.first,digits=3),
                                T ~ round(Pr...t..__orderNDM.first,digits=2)),

                estimate.value.session.mainEffect__NDM_ = round(estimate.value.session.mainEffect__NDM_,2)) %>%
  dplyr::rename("CDM (p, one-sample)"=p.value.session.mainEffect__CDM_,
                "NDM (p, one-sample)"=p.value.session.mainEffect__NDM_,
                'CDM&NDM (p,one-sample)'=p.value.bothSessions.mainEffect,
                'CDM&NDM (estimate)'=estimate.value.bothSessions.mainEffect,
                'CDM (estimate)' = estimate.value.session.mainEffect__CDM_,
                'NDM (estimate)' = estimate.value.session.mainEffect__NDM_)%>%
  dplyr::select(-contains('Pr...'),-contains('Estimate__'),-contains('Std..Error'),-contains('p.value.session.main'),-CDMmNDM.ctrHR.p) %>% #,-BF.mean.customSD) %>%
```

# Control analysis: hierarchical regression
I was very surprised to see that inclusion of the heart rate changed results so much. Therefore let's test it as a hierarchical model

What I think is the correct model:
- each person has as within-subject factors which session (CDM/NDM and 1st/2nd session the trial belongs to)
- session can interact with the task variables.

I don't understand why this does not give me the same result as the other, 2 level model that first fit each person's decisions, and then compared the regression weights on the group level, controlling for order.

I wonder whether it's something about the fact that heart rate and DV correlate quite strongly across all participants, but not within a person. And that mean heart rate is different between the groups.

Having thought about it more above, there is an A and A-B in the same regression issue.

In conclusion, we'll have the following equations for the task parameters:
- DV
- DV + mean(listen+reponseBPM)
- listenBPM + reponseBPM

For the session measures, we have:
- (session+session_time)
- (session*session_time)
- (session*order)

Print summary tables.
- all results from (session+session_time) 
- for the others: only the rows with interaction terms
Consider swapping dimensions to put more on the same
```{r}
df= cardio %>% dplyr::filter(Modality=='Intero') %>%
  dplyr::mutate(session_time = case_when(session=='CDM' &order=='CDM.first' ~ 'session1',
                                         session=='CDM' &order=='NDM.first' ~ 'session2',
                                         session=='NDM' &order=='CDM.first' ~ 'session2',
                                         session=='NDM' &order=='NDM.first' ~ 'session1'),
                Decision.num = case_when(Decision=='More' ~1,
                                         Decision=='Less' ~ 0)) %>%
  dplyr::select(ID,Decision,Decision.num,DV_ResponseMinListen,session,session_time,listenBPM,responseBPM,listen.responseBPM.mean,order) %>%ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate_at(c('DV_ResponseMinListen','listenBPM','responseBPM','listen.responseBPM.mean'),scale)


my.prior=c(prior(normal(0,3),class='b')) 

formulas.basic= c('(listenBPM+responseBPM)',
                  '(DV_ResponseMinListen+listen.responseBPM.mean)',
                  'DV_ResponseMinListen')
formulas.conditions = c('*(session+session_time)',
                        '*(session*session_time)',
                        '*(session*order)')
model.count=0;
for (ibasic in formulas.basic){
  for (icond in formulas.conditions){
    model.count=model.count+1
    this.file=file.path(paths$stats,paste0('Hierarchical_Interoception_model',model.count,'.csv'))
    this.file.long=file.path(paths$stats,paste0('Hierarchical_Interoception_model',model.count,'_check.txt'))
    if (!file.exists(this.file)){
      if (icond=='*(session*order)') {
        this.formula= paste0('Decision.num ~',ibasic,icond,'+ (',ibasic,'*session|ID)')
      } else{
        this.formula= paste0('Decision.num ~',ibasic,icond,'+ (',ibasic,icond,'|ID)')
      }
      
      print(this.formula)
      fit = brm(this.formula,
                data=df,family=bernoulli(link='logit'),prior=my.prior)
      write.csv(as.data.frame(fixef(fit)) %>% dplyr::mutate_if(is.numeric,~round(.,2)),this.file)
      sink(this.file.long)
      print(summary(fit))
      sink()
    }
  }
}


# Summarize the results
full.hier.res=data.frame()
for (im in 1:model.count){
  res=read.csv(file.path(paths$stats,paste0('Hierarchical_Interoception_model',im,'.csv')))
  if (!any(stringr::str_detect(res$X,'sessionNDM:session_timesession2')) &
      !any(stringr::str_detect(res$X,'sessionNDM:orderNDM.first'))){

  } else{
    full.hier.res= rbind(full.hier.res,res %>% dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(X,':')))
    print('should be not first')
  }
}
```

# Control analysis: task difficulty over time
Due to the adaptive staircasing procedure, task difficulty might be different across participants, so this might be problematic for regressions, especially when the data is z-scored within each person!
```{r}
df= cardio %>% dplyr::filter(Modality=='Intero') %>% dplyr::group_by(ID,session,order) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ntr = row_number()) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(ntr>= max(ntr)-4)  %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean.DV_ResponseMinListen = mean(DV_ResponseMinListen,na.rm=T)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(.,names_from='session',values_from='mean.DV_ResponseMinListen') %>%
  dplyr::mutate(mean.DV_CDMminNDM = CDM-NDM,
                mean.DV_CDMminNDM.abs = abs(CDM)-abs(NDM))


fit=brm(mean.DV_CDMminNDM.abs~order,data=df)
fit.lm=lm(mean.DV_CDMminNDM.abs~order,data=df)

fit2=brm(mean.DV_CDMminNDM~order,data=df)
fit2.lm=lm(mean.DV_CDMminNDM~order,data=df)
```

# Control analysis: ot
# Control analysis: analysing the original Legrand data
```{r}
# Compute variables
cardio.legrand.this = cardio.legrand %>% dplyr::group_by(ID,Modality)  %>%
  dplyr::mutate(DV_ResponseMinListen = responseBPM-listenBPM,
                rollingResponseAvg.5tr=rollapply(responseBPM,5,mean,align='right',fill=NA),
                rollingResponseAvg.5tr.prev= lag(rollingResponseAvg.5tr),
                DV_ResponseMinAvg5tr = responseBPM-rollingResponseAvg.5tr.prev,
                rollingHeartAvg.5tr=rollapply(listenBPM,5,mean,align='right',fill=NA),# to use in model: previous as the other one includes the current trial
                DV_ResponseMinAvgListen5tr=responseBPM-rollingHeartAvg.5tr,
                Decision = dplyr::recode(Decision,'More'=1,'Less'=0)) %>% dplyr::ungroup() 
# run regressions
results.indivModalities.legrand=data.frame()
results.logLiks.glms.legrand = data.frame()

for (isub in unique(cardio.legrand.this$ID)){
  for (imod in unique(cardio.legrand.this$Modality)){
    df= cardio.legrand.this %>% dplyr::filter( Modality==imod & ID==isub)
    
    glms=list()
    glms$dec = glm(Decision~ DV_ResponseMinListen,data=df,family='binomial')
    # Control analyses
    glms$dec.listenRespBPMsep = glm(Decision~ listenBPM+responseBPM,data=df,family='binomial')
    glms$avgBeep5tr.separate = glm(Decision~listenBPM+rollingResponseAvg.5tr.prev+responseBPM,data=df,family='binomial')
    glms$avgHeartRate5tr.separate = glm(Decision~rollingHeartAvg.5tr+responseBPM,data=df,family='binomial')
    
    # comparison: with avg vs with listen (remove NA so we have the same amount of trials for each)
    df.comparison= df %>% dplyr::select(Decision,DV_ResponseMinAvg5tr,DV_ResponseMinListen,DV_ResponseMinAvgListen5tr,responseBPM) %>% na.omit()
    glms$forLogLik.avgBeep5tr = glm(Decision ~ DV_ResponseMinAvg5tr,data=df.comparison,family='binomial')
    glms$forLogLik.listenBeep = glm(Decision ~ DV_ResponseMinListen,data=df.comparison,family='binomial')
    glms$forLogLik.responseBeepOnly = glm(Decision ~ responseBPM,data=df.comparison,family='binomial')
    glms$forLogLik.avgHeart5tr = glm(Decision ~ DV_ResponseMinAvgListen5tr,data=df.comparison,family='binomial')
    
    results.logLiks.glms.legrand=bind_rows(results.logLiks.glms.legrand,
                                           data.frame(ID=isub,Modality=imod,
                                                      logLik.avgBeep5tr=logLik(glms$forLogLik.avgBeep5tr),
                                                      logLik.listenBeep=logLik(glms$forLogLik.listenBeep),
                                                      logLik.responseBeepOnly = logLik( glms$forLogLik.responseBeepOnly),
                                                      logLik.responesBeepAvg5trlisten = logLik(glms$forLogLik.avgHeart5tr)))
    
    for (ireg in names(glms)){
        t=as.data.frame(summary(glms[[ireg]])$coefficients) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column() %>%
          dplyr::mutate(ID=isub,Modality=imod,regression=ireg)
        results.indivModalities.legrand=bind_rows(results.indivModalities.legrand,t)
      }
  }
}

```

Hierarchical regression
```{r}
my.prior=c(prior(normal(0,3),class='b')) 
df= cardio.legrand.this %>% dplyr::filter(Modality=='Intero') %>% dplyr::mutate_if(is.numeric,scale)
fit.legrand.listenBPM.intero = brm(Decision~ (responseBPM + listenBPM) + (responseBPM+ listenBPM|ID) ,
          data=df,family=bernoulli(link='logit'),prior=my.prior)
fit.legrand.listenBPM5trAvg.intero = brm(Decision~ (responseBPM + rollingHeartAvg.5tr) + (responseBPM+ rollingHeartAvg.5tr|ID) ,
          data=df,family=bernoulli(link='logit'),prior=my.prior)
fit.legrand.soundBPM5trAvg.intero = brm(Decision~ (responseBPM + rollingResponseAvg.5tr.prev) + (responseBPM+ rollingResponseAvg.5tr.prev|ID) ,
          data=df,family=bernoulli(link='logit'),prior=my.prior)
fit.legrand.soundBPM5trAvg.hear5travg.intero = brm(Decision~ (responseBPM + rollingResponseAvg.5tr.prev + rollingHeartAvg.5tr) + 
                                                             (responseBPM+  rollingResponseAvg.5tr.prev+  rollingHeartAvg.5tr|ID) ,
          data=df,family=bernoulli(link='logit'),prior=my.prior)

sink(file.path(paths$stats,'Legrand_HierarchicalRegression_Interoception.txt'))
print(summary(fit.legrand.listenBPM.intero))
print(summary(fit.legrand.listenBPM5trAvg.intero))
print(summary(fit.legrand.soundBPM5trAvg.intero))
print(summary(fit.legrand.soundBPM5trAvg.hear5travg.intero))
sink()

p= conditional_effects(fit.legrand.listenBPM.intero, effects = 'listenBPM', robust = TRUE) 
p1=plot(p,points = F, plot = F)[[1]]
p= conditional_effects(fit.legrand.listenBPM.intero, effects = 'responseBPM', robust = TRUE) 
p2=plot(p,points = F, plot = F)[[1]]
plot.listenBPM=ggarrange(p1,p2)

p= conditional_effects(fit.legrand.listenBPM5trAvg.intero, effects = 'rollingHeartAvg.5tr', robust = TRUE) 
p1=plot(p,points = F, plot = F)[[1]]
p= conditional_effects(fit.legrand.listenBPM5trAvg.intero, effects = 'responseBPM', robust = TRUE) 
p2=plot(p,points = F, plot = F)[[1]]
plot.listenBPM.avg=ggarrange(p1,p2)

p= conditional_effects(fit.legrand.soundBPM5trAvg.intero, effects = 'rollingResponseAvg.5tr.prev', robust = TRUE) 
p1=plot(p,points = F, plot = F)[[1]]
p= conditional_effects(fit.legrand.soundBPM5trAvg.intero, effects = 'responseBPM', robust = TRUE) 
p2=plot(p,points = F, plot = F)[[1]]
plot.soundBPM.avg=ggarrange(p1,p2)


out=ggarrange(plot.listenBPM,plot.listenBPM.avg,plot.soundBPM.avg, nrow=3)
ggexport(out, filename=file.path(paths$figures,'Legrand_HierarchicalRegression_Interoception_differentSettings.tiff'),
         width = 7 * 300,  # Width in pixels (7 inches at 300 DPI)
         height = 7 * 300,  # Height in pixels (reduced height)
         res = 300)
```

#TP code: CDM + NDM confidence values for ext and int with a p value
```{r}
# Create an empty results table
confidence_NDMPlusCDM_P_Values <- data.frame()

# Define targets
target_rows <- c('Intercept', 'Stimulus easiness')
modalities <- c('Extero', 'Intero')

# Loop through all combinations
for (rname in target_rows) {
  for (mod in modalities) {
    # Filter the relevant rows
    df_sub <- df %>%
      filter(rowname == rname,
             regression == 'conf',
             Modality == mod)

    # Compute mean of NDM + CDM by ID
    df_avg <- df_sub %>%
      group_by(ID, session) %>%
      summarise(Estimate = mean(Estimate), .groups = "drop") %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = session, values_from = Estimate) %>%
      mutate(mean_NDMplusCDM = rowMeans(select(., c(NDM, CDM)), na.rm = TRUE))

    # Run t-test on that mean
    t_result <- t.test(df_avg$mean_NDMplusCDM, mu = 0)

    # Save results
    confidence_NDMPlusCDM_P_Values <- bind_rows(
      confidence_NDMPlusCDM_P_Values,
      tibble(
        rowname = rname,
        modality = mod,
        t_statistic = t_result$statistic,
        p_value = t_result$p.value,
        mean = mean(df_avg$mean_NDMplusCDM, na.rm = TRUE),
        se = sd(df_avg$mean_NDMplusCDM, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(nrow(df_avg)),
        n = nrow(df_avg),
        formatted_p = ifelse(
          t_result$p.value < .001, "p < .001",
          paste0("p = ", formatC(t_result$p.value, format = "f", digits = 3))
        )
      )
    )
  }
}

# Show results
print(confidence_NDMPlusCDM_P_Values)

```
